abstract_sentences.text: Computing the polar decomposition and the related matrix sign function has been a well-studied problem in numerical analysis for decades.

evidence.anchor: polar decomposition and the related matrix sign function

abstract_sentences.text: Recently, it has emerged as an important subroutine within the Muon optimizer for training deep neural networks.

evidence.anchor: important subroutine within the Muon optimizer

abstract_sentences.text: However, the requirements of this application differ sharply from classical settings: deep learning demands GPU-friendly algorithms that prioritize high throughput over high precision.

evidence.anchor: prioritize high throughput over high precision

abstract_sentences.text: We introduce Polar Express, a new method for computing the polar decomposition.

evidence.anchor: We introduce Polar Express

abstract_sentences.text: Like Newton-Schulz and other classical polynomial methods, our approach uses only matrix-matrix multiplications, making it very efficient on GPUs.

evidence.anchor: uses only matrix-matrix multiplications

abstract_sentences.text: Inspired by earlier work of Chen & Chow and Nakatsukasa & Freund, Polar Express adapts the update rule at each iteration by solving a minimax optimization problem.

evidence.anchor: adapts the update rule at each iteration

abstract_sentences.text: We prove that this strategy minimizes error in a worst-case sense, allowing Polar Express to converge as rapidly as possible both in the early iterations and asymptotically.

evidence.anchor: minimizes error in a worst-case sense

abstract_sentences.text: We also address finite-precision issues, making it practical to use in bfloat16.

evidence.anchor: practical to use in bfloat16

abstract_sentences.text: When integrated into Muon, our method yields consistent improvements in validation loss for a GPT-2 model trained on one to ten billion tokens from the FineWeb dataset, outperforming recent alternatives across a range of learning rates.

claim_closure.conclusion_response: The ablation recovers 5–6 for Muon utility; it does not close a general matrix-accuracy claim.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把 Muon 的 polar/sign 近似转化为区间上的 odd-polynomial composition；逐步 minimax 选择经 Theorem 3.1 升格为全局 worst-case 最优，Theorem 3.3 给出 degree-dependent 超指数收敛，再用 bfloat16 稳定化和 GPT-2 loss 验证任务效用。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 保留 Muon/polar 定义、GPU 原语、公式 (5)→(6)、Theorem 3.1/3.3 结论、Algorithm 1、ell=10^-3、degree 5、5–6 iterations、Figure 3、Figures 1/4/5/6。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 证明、完整 Remez/系数代码、finite-precision 机制、Frobenius/cosine 与 small-singular-value 检验、CIFAR/ViT 负面结果、谱隙初始化和 rectangular iteration 放入 Appendix A–J；严格核查强主张必须回到附录。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 公式 (5)→(6) 的矩阵-标量等价、Figure 2 的区间收缩、Algorithm 1 的 offline/online 分界、Figure 5 的 accuracy/runtime 双面板共同区分理论精度与 Muon 所需精度。
final_judgment.largest_gap: “consistent improvements”主要由 GPT-2/FineWeb、最佳学习率 sweep 和主文无 seed/不确定性支撑；跨任务附录显示优势不稳定，inexact Muon 桥接依赖外部分析而非本文重证。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 对可组合迭代方法，先证明局部 minimax 选择能否保留为全局 composition 最优，再用机制图和任务效用/成本消融分离数学精度与应用所需精度。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 规则要求状态可由区间或可验证集合描述、组件选择可组合且任务效用可观测；分布漂移、非区间状态、随机优化耦合和跨任务泛化需要独立实验与不确定性报告。
